body:
Audit complete and recorded in full on bd-01M1CQCSZSTHJQ5PA4PQ4GWKVB; no edits/reservations/downloads.

Seam: StorySource.fromText -> SurfaceAnalyzer.analyze -> ParserSentenceInput.fromAtlas -> ParserBatch.validated -> missing concrete ParserTransport -> JsonAmrCandidateProvider.parse -> ParserBatchResult.conforms -> ParserProposal.evidence; internally AmrCandidates.fromPenman -> RoleCanonicalizer.fromUnchecked -> ToChart.convert -> PropositionEvidence.of. It then stops: NarrativeCompilerInput.of requires situation/context/summary/segment/(causal) attempts, and no production chart-to-attempt producer exists. Thereafter the existing seam is NarrativeCompiler.compile -> NarrativeCompilation.validated -> StorySourceView.validated; RecallSegmenter.segment -> CandidateGenerator.generate -> GraphHsmm.infer (P/F).

No existing end-to-end path answers the accepted P1 v3 Baseball Diagnostic. Alice is predeclared but lacks an admitted derived ledger/current artifact. NFRD Baseball is in unlanded 99602ba with 113 external recalls, and that snapshot is not currently materialized. Sherlock recalls depend on later film compilation and are not a P1 substitute. Existing PopulationAggregate eligibility is outcome-dependent and lacks the accepted revisit/compression/blending report; one transcript cannot answer a population question.

Two hard scope defects: fixturesJVM cannot import providerParser without build.sbt dependency work; and ParserTransport returns only response bytes, so fake/live transports are observationally identical while JsonAmrCandidateProvider mints the receipt. A real fake-substitution court needs an execution witness joined into contract/conforming/result, outside the nine paths.

Recommendation: split A transport/runtime proof (rescope current author to subprocess plus contract/conforming/result and focused foreign source/runtime/config/cache + fake-substitution courts) from B scientific Baseball vertical after NFRD lands (chart-to-narrative proposal provider, declared dense semantic channel where used, accepted P1 report, JVM embed-bench integration). B needs ADR/path authorization.
